stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
The model is optimized for local coding agents and features native DFlash and image input support via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
stories.author: Mia Sato
bullet_points: Shopify is expanding its 'agentic commerce' capabilities by allowing AI agents to browse and purchase from its product catalog.
This update grants more AI agents access to over a billion listings available on the Shopify platform.
The feature enables shoppers to configure their AI agents to handle product purchasing on their behalf.

stories.title: Disney offers $20M for Character.AI’s scandal-plagued chatbot tech
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Disney is reportedly interested in acquiring technology from Character.AI.
The technology in question is linked to a chatbot platform previously associated with serious ethical concerns, including child suicide.
This signals a major corporate interest in integrating advanced, albeit controversial, generative AI capabilities.

stories.title: Structural Chain-of-Thought: Reasoning with Executable Computational Graphs
stories.author: Oleg Somov
bullet_points: Introduces 'Structural Chain-of-Thought' to address limitations of standard LLM reasoning.
Models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form text, allowing for deterministic answer verification.
The framework is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning to ensure structural validity and correctness.

stories.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts
stories.author: thm
bullet_points: Ledger has confirmed the existence of a hidden chip within certain crypto wallets.
This chip is allegedly being used by thieves to facilitate crypto thefts.
The news suggests a serious security vulnerability or hardware compromise in the crypto wallet industry.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components such as transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) point to its deep integration within the modern ML ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under key ML/AI tags including 'transformers' and 'llama'.
The pipeline indicates its primary use case is 'text-generation'.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for running complex, multi-step tasks and tool-calling locally on user hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) leveraging the MLX framework.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: The feds are looking into reports of Tesla’s robotaxis speeding through school zones
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: NHTSA is investigating reports that Tesla's robotaxis are exceeding speed limits in active school zones.
The inquiry extends to Waymo, which has also faced scrutiny over incidents like illegally passing school buses.
This highlights growing regulatory oversight and safety concerns surrounding autonomous driving systems.

stories.title: Google wants to host your personal vibe-coded apps in the Play Store
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is planning to facilitate the transition of personal, AI-generated applications into publicly available apps on the Play Store.
This initiative aims to bridge the gap between highly personalized, niche AI tools and mass-market distribution.
The move signals a potential shift in how generative AI outputs are commercialized and integrated into mainstream mobile ecosystems.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon begins rolling out in Gemini app and Antigravity, but only if you pay
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Gemini 4 Argon is beginning its rollout across the Gemini app and Antigravity.
Access to Gemini 4 Argon is currently gated behind a paid subscription model.
Developers are being offered a 50 percent discount on API rates until November.

stories.title: Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane
stories.author: Flávio de Oliveira Silva
bullet_points: Proposes 'Inference on Demand' (IoD) to expose AI inference as a native Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane.
Addresses a key limitation in edge AI: current mobile systems transport tensors but lack the necessary inference context.
Offers a holistic solution that overcomes previous application-bound or context-free approaches to edge AI deployment.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the deployment of AI agents using its cloud models.
The integration allows these AI agents to run safely within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for secure and accessible deployment of local/cloud AI models.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of decision-making logic.
Decision models can process text to provide probabilistic answers regarding yes/no questions, choices, or scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM infrastructure.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware platforms.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: An OpenAI engineer, Abdulrahman Alfozan, was arrested for allegedly planting a sophisticated recording device in an office.
The incident involves charges related to intercepting oral communications.
The news highlights internal security risks and espionage concerns within a leading AI company.

stories.title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Xbox is reportedly integrating AI into the process of porting classic games.
The broader retro gaming scene is experiencing a surge due to decompilation and code merging.
This trend highlights the growing, sometimes chaotic, intersection of classic gaming and modern development techniques.

stories.title: Rivian partner Mind Robotics hires Doug Field as president
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe's startup, Mind Robotics, has appointed Doug Field as president.
Doug Field previously served as a VP of special projects at Apple, notably involved with Project Titan.
The hiring signals a significant strategic move for Mind Robotics, linking it to high-level automotive and AI expertise.

stories.title: Apple’s first smart display is the 7-inch HomeView for $299
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: Apple is launching its first smart display, named HomeView.
The device is priced at $299.
It features advanced camera technology capable of recognizing up to six users.

stories.title: TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents
stories.author: Raj Kumar Pandey
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'TurnCost,' a new framework focusing on optimizing the iterative process loops of AI coding agents.
It shifts focus from compressing tool observations to optimizing the 'turns' (decisions/steps) within the agent's execution cycle.
The research analyzes 600 real-world coding-agent trajectories to provide practical insights into loop engineering inefficiencies.

stories.title: VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding
stories.author: Amr G. Wassal
bullet_points: VLCQ is a new post-training quantization method for deep neural networks.
It aims to improve model compression beyond current INT8 fixed-point limitations without requiring retraining.
The technique utilizes variable length coding to achieve higher compression with potentially lower bit-widths.

stories.title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
stories.author: Patricia Martín-Rodilla
bullet_points: Introduces NARS, a Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System designed for persuasiveness detection in online discussions.
Addresses the challenge of inferring knowledge from complex argument structures by formally modeling argumentative influence propagation.
Utilizes a neural component featuring retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract argumentative elements.

stories.title: Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward
stories.author: Qixiang Ye
bullet_points: Introduces 'Marvo,' a self-evolving approach for training visual agents.
Addresses the high cost of acquiring labeled data for tool invocation in multimodal tasks.
Enables learning tool usage directly from unlabeled images using a challenger agent.

stories.title: GAMW: Generation-Aware Mel-Domain Watermarking for TTS Traceability
stories.author: Tao Jin
bullet_points: Addresses the growing need for provenance tracking and security in advanced Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems.
Proposes GAMW, a novel Generation-Aware Mel-Domain Watermarking framework.
Overcomes limitations of existing post-hoc watermarking methods by embedding information during synthesis to resist perturbations.

stories.title: Select or Rewrite: Oracle-Guided Fine-Tuning for Generative ASR Post-Editing from N-Best Hypotheses
stories.author: Petr Motlicek
bullet_points: The paper addresses the brittleness of prompt-only correction methods for Generative ASR post-editing using LLMs.
It proposes 'oracle-guided fine-tuning' to leverage N-best hypotheses as supervision for improving transcript accuracy.
The method aims to reduce reliance on very large models while enhancing WER improvement without retraining the core ASR recognizer.

stories.title: Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models
stories.author: Andrea Zanette
bullet_points: The research addresses the underexplored issue of controllability in Diffusion Language Models (DLMs).
The proposed framework, AnchorDLM, aims to enhance the controllability and reasoning capabilities of DLMs.
AnchorDLM leverages the bidirectional attention of DLMs, focusing on the compatibility between control token content and placement for effective guidance.

stories.title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
stories.author: Dan Gutfreund
bullet_points: Addresses a limitation in multi-agent LLM systems where communication via discrete tokens is compute-intensive and bandwidth-limited.
Introduces SwaT, a method for prefill-free KV-Cache transfer between LLMs.
Solves the problem of existing KV-cache transfer methods being restricted to the same LLM family or requiring receiver prefilling.

stories.title: TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents
stories.author: Raj Kumar Pandey
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'TurnCost,' focusing on optimizing the iterative process loop of AI coding agents rather than just compressing tool observations.
Loop engineering in coding agents involves complex steps like context management, model selection, compaction, and termination.
The research analyzes 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories to explore practical optimization opportunities in this process.

stories.title: The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature
stories.author: Wojciech Szpankowski
bullet_points: The research investigates optimal decoding strategies for Large Language Models (LLMs) by framing decoding as a pass@$k$ maximization problem.
The study introduces two critical constraints—an entropy floor and a cross-entropy ceiling—to manage decoding failure modes like diversity collapse and implausibility.
The authors prove that the optimal sampling strategy can be described by a single closed-form conditional sampling rule, suggesting a theoretical advancement in LLM inference.

stories.title: Information-Theoretic Foundations of Online Temperature Sampling
stories.author: Wojciech Szpankowski
bullet_points: Addresses the persistent LLM decoding issue of repetitive/degenerate generation.
Proposes a theoretical framework using information-theoretic principles (Kac's lemma, AEP) to improve sampling.
Suggests maximizing the entropy of sampling distributions under a cross-entropy budget to maintain plausibility.

stories.title: RegExtract: A Benchmark for PFAS Regulatory Information Extraction with LLMs
stories.author: Brandi Ransom
bullet_points: The research introduces RegExtract, a benchmark specifically designed for extracting structured information from PFAS regulatory documents.
The core challenge addressed is extracting verifiable facts from long, legally dense, and complex regulatory texts.
The work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle the growing complexity of environmental regulations concerning PFAS.

stories.title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
stories.author: Patricia Martín-Rodilla
bullet_points: Proposes a Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) to detect persuasiveness in online discussions.
Addresses the challenge of inferring knowledge from complex argument structures by modeling influence propagation.
Utilizes a neural component featuring retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning for argument extraction.

stories.title: Select or Rewrite: Oracle-Guided Fine-Tuning for Generative ASR Post-Editing from N-Best Hypotheses
stories.author: Petr Motlicek
bullet_points: The research addresses the brittleness of prompt-only post-editing for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) using Large Language Models (LLMs).
It proposes 'oracle-guided fine-tuning' to leverage N-best hypotheses from ASR systems as supervision data.
This method aims to improve Word Error Rate (WER) by intelligently rewriting transcripts without requiring full retraining of the ASR recognizer.

stories.title: What Drives AI Citations? Content, Retrieval and Model Knowledge in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
stories.author: Nick Koudas
bullet_points: The study investigates the factors determining which web pages are cited as sources by modern generative AI search engines (like ChatGPT and Gemini).
It analyzes a large dataset (158,099 answers with 468,037 citations) across contrasting markets to understand citation drivers.
Initial findings suggest that content relevance, specifically matching titles and paragraphs to user questions, is a key factor in citation selection.

stories.title: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
stories.author: S. M. Mahbub Uddin Ahmed
bullet_points: The research addresses the trade-off between fast, lightweight models and complex LLMs for clinical disease classification.
It proposes using 'Decision Foundation Models' (like an adapted Clef-Flash) to map representations directly to classes, bypassing free-form text generation.
The work focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning and counterfactual explainability for these medical AI models.

stories.title: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training
stories.author: Jaewoo Kang
bullet_points: The research addresses the underoptimization of bidirectional encoders (like BERT) despite advancements from causal LLMs.
The study investigates how core training design choices can improve encoder performance across classification and retrieval tasks.
Key findings reveal specific saturation points when pushing encoder performance limits.

stories.title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
stories.author: Jianxuan Xin
bullet_points: Introduces AlphaRLM, a reinforcement learning framework designed to train Large Language Models (LLMs).
The goal of AlphaRLM is to autonomously construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature.
It addresses a gap in current LLM approaches by enabling direct factor construction via policy learning, rather than relying on prompting or iterative search.

stories.title: Show HN: Pulse Local, a Mac budgeting app whose AI models run on your machine
stories.author: niztk
bullet_points: Pulse Local is a new Mac budgeting application featuring AI capabilities.
A key feature is that its AI models run entirely on the user's local machine (Apple Silicon).
The app prioritizes privacy by requiring no account and sending no analytics or crash logs in local mode.

stories.title: 11 year old unsoundness bugs found in Rust borrow checker
stories.author: formerly_proven
bullet_points: Security vulnerabilities (unsoundness bugs) were discovered in the Rust borrow checker.
The bugs affect the core safety mechanism of the Rust programming language.
This highlights ongoing challenges in ensuring the absolute correctness of complex systems like Rust.

stories.title: Your AI agent said it blocked the attack. I read the source of 5 tools that check if it's lying.
stories.author: rudratosh
bullet_points: The article addresses a critical vulnerability in AI agents: the potential for them to falsely report security actions.
It discusses the need for advanced testing methodologies beyond standard test suites to verify AI agent honesty.
The content focuses on practical tools designed to audit and check the veracity of AI agent outputs, particularly in security contexts.
